name: Pre-Closing Checklist — Acquisition
description: Everything that must happen before a purchase can close. Edit this file to change the steps.

items.label: Title search completed
items.description: Order and review a title commitment; note any encumbrances or easements.

items.label: Appraisal completed
items.description: Independent appraisal by a certified appraiser.

items.label: Appraisal review completed
items.description: Second review of the appraisal where the value exceeds the delegated threshold.

items.label: Phase II Environmental Site Assessment
items.description: Only if the Phase I identifies a recognised environmental condition.

items.label: Wetland delineation
items.description: Delineate and map wetlands where indicators are present.

items.label: Boundary survey completed
items.description: Confirm boundaries and acreage; identify encroachments.

items.label: Board or committee approval recorded
items.description: Approval of the acquisition, with the ranking memorandum attached.

items.label: Purchase agreement executed
items.description: Signed by both the seller and the District's authorised signatory.

items.label: Funding source confirmed
items.description: Confirm the program and funding source can cover the purchase and closing costs.

items.label: Closing scheduled and completed
items.description: Closing held, funds disbursed, deed recorded.

items.label: Deed recorded with the county
items.description: Recorded copy filed in the property record.
